# Prabhu Saravanan — Lead Data Engineer

> Portfolio of Prabhu Saravanan, a Lead Data Engineer (8 years) building lakehouse, streaming and governed AI data platforms on Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka and dbt. Based in Abu Dhabi, UAE; open to roles in the UAE, Europe and India.
